title: Karman Space & Defense Awarded $31 Million U.S. Navy Contract for Virginia-class Submarine Propulsor Tailcones
summary: Karman Space & Defense Awarded $31 Million U.S. Navy Contract for Virginia-class Submarine Propulsor Tailcones. Karman Space & Defense (NYSE: KRMN) has been awarded a five-year, $31 million contract by the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Carderock Division, to produce propulsor tailcones for the U.S. Navy’s Virginia-class attack submarines.
body_markdown:
Virginia-class fast-attack submarine USS Colorado (SSN 788) returns from sea trials at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam on June 6, 2026.


- Secures long-lead materials for Block VI Virginia-class submarines
- Supports production readiness and reduces manufacturing risk
- Expands Karman’s role supporting U.S. Navy submarine programs


**HUNTINGTON BEACH, Calif. (BUSINESS WIRE) —** Karman Space & Defense (NYSE: KRMN) has been awarded a five-year, $31 million contract by the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Carderock Division, to produce propulsor tailcones for the U.S. Navy’s Virginia-class attack submarines.


The award helps the Navy secure long-lead materials, reduce production risk and strengthen the submarine industrial base.


“The Navy’s ability to expand submarine production depends on a reliable industrial base capable of delivering highly specialized capabilities at scale,” said Jon Rambeau, chief executive officer of Karman Space & Defense. “Meeting that challenge requires sustained investment in advanced manufacturing capabilities and a relentless focus on execution.”


The contract is structured primarily as firm-fixed-price, with cost-plus-fixed-fee options for nonrecurring engineering and specialized engineering services supporting manufacturing strategy development and production implementation.


The award builds on Karman’s longstanding involvement in submarine programs, expanding the company’s content on Virginia-class submarines and reinforcing its role in supporting the Navy’s production requirements.


Karman’s Gulfport, Mississippi, operations bring decades of deep engineering and manufacturing experience to the nation’s submarine programs. The team produces composite structures and propulsion-related components designed to meet the demanding performance and reliability requirements of undersea missions.


**About Karman Space & Defense**


Karman Space & Defense is the specialized engineering and manufacturing partner behind many of the nation’s most critical space and defense programs. Karman designs and produces mission-critical subsystems that must perform under the most extreme conditions and delivers them at speed and scale to support today’s demand and the missions of tomorrow.
